cat > /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup <<'ANTRIEB_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
umask 077
. /etc/inventory-backup.conf
source_dir=/srv/inventory/data
destination=/var/backups/inventory
archive="inventory-$(date +%F).tar.gz"
local_tmp=$(mktemp /var/tmp/inventory-backup.XXXXXX.tar.gz)
remote_tmp="$destination/.$archive.part"
remote_final="$destination/$archive"
cleanup() {
    rm -f "$local_tmp"
    ssh -i /root/.ssh/inventory_backup_ed25519 \
        -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
        -o UserKnownHostsFile=/root/.ssh/inventory_backup_known_hosts \
        "inventory-backup@$BACKUP_HOST" "rm -f '$remote_tmp'" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
test -d "$source_dir"
tar -C /srv/inventory -czf "$local_tmp" data
tar -tzf "$local_tmp" >/dev/null
checksum=$(sha256sum "$local_tmp" | awk '{print $1}')
ssh_opts="-i /root/.ssh/inventory_backup_ed25519 -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=/root/.ssh/inventory_backup_known_hosts"
ssh $ssh_opts "inventory-backup@$BACKUP_HOST" "cat > '$remote_tmp'" < "$local_tmp"
ssh $ssh_opts "inventory-backup@$BACKUP_HOST" "
    set -eu
    actual=\$(sha256sum '$remote_tmp' | awk '{print \$1}')
    test \"\$actual\" = '$checksum'
    mv -f '$remote_tmp' '$remote_final'
    find '$destination' -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'inventory-????-??-??.tar.gz' -mtime +6 -delete
    printf 'archive=%s sha256=%s\n' '$remote_final' \"\$actual\"
"
ANTRIEB_SCRIPT
chmod 0700 /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.service <<'ANTRIEB_SERVICE'
[Unit]
Description=Back up inventory data to node1
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/flock -n /run/inventory-backup.lock /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup
PrivateTmp=no

ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=read-only
ReadWritePaths=/var/tmp
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6

OnCalendar=*-*-* 02:00:00

Unit=inventory-backup.service

[Install]
